def: A modular open-source RL library for training LLM agents on long-horizon tasks, from Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab (NovaSky) with Anyscale, split into training, environment and agent components.
practice: Used for agentic RL on tasks such as SWE-bench-style coding and text-to-SQL; its skyrl-gym environments follow the Gymnasium API, and it integrates with OpenEnv.
